Residential solar panel efficiency in 2025

Typical residential monocrystalline panels sold in 2025 convert between 20% and 22% of sunlight into electricity. Premium models from the top three manufacturers reach 22.8% under standard test conditions.

Degradation

Manufacturers warrant output at 84.8% of the original rating after 25 years, which works out to a degradation rate of about 0.55% per year for modern panels.

Cost

The installed cost of a residential system in the survey averaged $2.75 per watt before incentives. A typical 7 kW system therefore costs about $19,250 before the federal credit.
